# Community Fund — Application Review Conversation

Reviewer script, 2026 round.

## Section 1 — All applicants

1. In one or two sentences, what will this money pay for?
2. Which community does the work serve, and roughly how many people?
3. What is the total amount you are requesting?
4. Over what period will the money be spent?
5. Who else is funding this work, if anyone?

## Section 2 — All applicants

6. How did you decide this was the need to address?
7. Who was involved in shaping the proposal?
8. What happens to the work if this application is unsuccessful?

## Section 3 — Applicants requesting more than £50,000

9. Which named individual holds financial responsibility for the grant?
10. Describe your reserves policy and current reserve level.
11. When were your last accounts independently examined or audited?
12. What is your process for authorising expenditure above £5,000?

## Section 4 — Applicants who have held a Community Fund grant before

13. What did the previous grant achieve against what you said it would?
14. What did you learn that changed how you work?
15. Was any of the previous grant returned or repurposed, and why?

## Section 5 — Applicants delivering services directly to children or vulnerable adults

16. What safeguarding policy is in place and when was it last reviewed?
17. How are staff and volunteers checked before they begin?
18. Who would a participant tell if something went wrong?

## Section 6 — Applicants constituted for less than two years

19. What governance structure is in place today?
20. Who are your trustees or directors, and what do they bring?
21. What would happen to the work if your founder stepped away tomorrow?

## Section 7 — Applicants requesting funding for capital works or equipment

22. Who will own the asset at the end of the funding period?
23. What is the expected working life of what you are buying?
24. How will running and maintenance costs be met afterwards?

## Section 8 — All applicants

25. What would success look like eighteen months from now?
26. What is the biggest risk to delivering it?
27. Is there anything about the application you would like to correct or add?
